posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
I use heating pads for placement under the alcohol baths to warm them up to 70 - 90 F. We can do room temperature but the heat does yeild more broadband and brighter holo's most of the time. Although being in the south the ambient temp will probably be in the 70's to 80's anyway. 

For the table protector, just ordinary green lawn trash bags that can be discarded afterwards.

Spacers can be black painted bolts, or anything really.
